scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed/adequate with substantial friction, 7 good with clear limitations, 9 excellent, 10 exceptional. Subjective holistic evaluation of observed emulated mobile play; wins and mission stats are not the grade. Overall is a judgment, not an arithmetic average.

reasons.overallMobile: A coherent complete mission with helpful touch assistance, clear recover/coil/upload progression and a strong visual identity. Crowded HUD and limited manual-control evidence constrain the grade.
reasons.controls: Large anchored controls, tap centering, AIM, automatic/manual reload and route assistance worked in samples. Manual stick only sampled briefly forward; FIRE drag sampled briefly. FACE COILS plus FIRE changed target orientation; precision and continuous two-thumb handling remain uncertain.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, shield pressure, timed armor windows and deck defense give observable progression and decisions. Both attempts relied heavily on route assistance. Cannot infer challenge depth or enjoyment of unassessed mechanics.
reasons.presentation: Consistent restrained cyan/amber palette, rain, industrial silhouettes, dimensional weapon view and polished title/result screens. Audio not assessed.
reasons.usability: Visible handbook, changing hold labels, planning map, status percentages and detailed fresh-start result screen help completion. Handbook lower paragraphs clipped behind its scroll region at this viewport, though scroll hint is present. Tools tray adds an extra opening step. Selector error is tooling friction, not counted as a game defect.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and main objectives stand out. Tiny environmental labels, small enemies, dark low-contrast geometry and stacked route/threat/tutorial overlays compete at 844x390.

helpful: AIM visibly magnifies target and iron sight

Small target silhouettes and scene lettering against dark geometry

Cannot establish continuous combat challenge or enjoyment from paused input
No claim that mission time improvement is a quality benefit or a reaction-time measure
